class Bag {
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<List<int>> Lists=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<Dictionary<string,int>> Maps=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<(int,int)> Pairs=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<(List<int>,int)> WithList=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<((int,int),int)> Nested=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<List<int>?> Optional=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<(int,int)?> OptionalPairs=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<List<Item>> Classes=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<(Item,int)> ClassPairs=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<int> Scalars=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<Item> DirectClasses=[];
class G<T> {
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<List<T>> Items=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<(T,int)> Pairs=[];
@settings(kind: .Unordered) public List<Dictionary<string,T>> MapRows=[];
public bool WriteEntries(T value) {Items.Add([value]); Pairs.Add((value,1)); MapRows.Add({"a":value}); return true;}

public bool ReadAndMutate(T value) {foreach(List<T> row in Items) {row.Add(value); if(row[0]!=value || row[1]!=value)return false;} foreach((T,int) row in Pairs) {if(row.Item1!=value)return false;} foreach(Dictionary<string,T> row in MapRows) {row["b"]=value; if(row["a"]!=value || row["b"]!=value)return false;} return Items.Count==1 && Pairs.Count==1 && MapRows.Count==1;}
public bool ClearEntries() {Items.Clear(); Pairs.Clear(); MapRows.Clear(); return Items.Count==0 && Pairs.Count==0 && MapRows.Count==0;}
class Caller<U> {public bool Write(G<int> target) {target.Items.Add([7]); foreach(List<int> row in target.Items) {return row[0]==7;} return false;} }
class Probe {
public static bool NestedList() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Lists.Add([1,2]); foreach (List<int> row in b.Lists) {return row[0]==1 && row[1]==2;} return false;}
public static bool NestedListMutation() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Lists.Add([1]); foreach (List<int> row in b.Lists) {row.Add(2); return row[1]==2;} return false;}
public static bool Dictionary() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Maps.Add({"a":1}); foreach (Dictionary<string,int> row in b.Maps) {row["b"]=2; return row["a"]==1 && row["b"]==2;} return false;}
public static bool Tuple() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Pairs.Add((1,2)); foreach ((int,int) row in b.Pairs) {return row.Item1==1 && row.Item2==2;} return false;}
public static bool TupleWithList() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.WithList.Add(([1],2)); foreach ((List<int>,int) row in b.WithList) {return row.Item1[0]==1 && row.Item2==2;} return false;}
public static bool NestedTuple() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Nested.Add(((1,2),3)); foreach (((int,int),int) row in b.Nested) {return row.Item1.Item2==2 && row.Item2==3;} return false;}
public static bool NullableList() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Optional.Add(null); b.Optional.Add([2]); int n=0; foreach (List<int>? row in b.Optional) {if(row==null){n+=1;}else{n+=row[0];}} return n==3;}

public static bool NullableTuple() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.OptionalPairs.Add(null); b.OptionalPairs.Add((2,3)); int n=0; foreach ((int,int)? row in b.OptionalPairs) {if(row==null){n+=1;}else{n+=row!.Item1;}} return n==3;}
public static bool EmptyComposite() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Lists.Add([]); b.Maps.Add({}); return b.Lists.Count==1 && b.Maps.Count==1;}
public static bool MultipleAdds() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Lists.Add([1]); b.Lists.Add([2]); int total=0; foreach(List<int> row in b.Lists) {total+=row[0];} return total==3 && b.Lists.Count==2;}
public static bool ClearComposite() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Lists.Add([1]); b.Lists.Clear(); return b.Lists.Count==0;}
public static bool RemoveTuple() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Pairs.Add((1,2)); b.Pairs.Remove((1,2)); return b.Pairs.Count==0;}
public static bool ClassInList() {Bag b=new Bag(); Item i=new Item(); i.V=3; b.Classes.Add([i]); i.V=4; foreach(List<Item> row in b.Classes) {return row[0].V==4;} return false;}
public static bool ClassInTuple() {Bag b=new Bag(); Item i=new Item(); i.V=3; b.ClassPairs.Add((i,1)); i.V=4; foreach((Item,int) row in b.ClassPairs) {return row.Item1.V==4;} return false;}
public static bool GenericInt() {G<int> g=new G<int>(); g.Items.Add([2]); foreach(List<int> row in g.Items) {row.Add(3); return row[1]==3;} return false;}
public static bool GenericString() {G<string> g=new G<string>(); g.Items.Add(["x"]); foreach(List<string> row in g.Items) {row.Add("y"); return row[1]=="y";} return false;}
public static bool GenericTuple() {G<string> g=new G<string>(); g.Pairs.Add(("x",1)); foreach((string,int) row in g.Pairs) {return row.Item1=="x";} return false;}
public static bool GenericDictionary() {G<int> g=new G<int>(); g.MapRows.Add({"a":2}); foreach(Dictionary<string,int> row in g.MapRows) {row["b"]=3; return row["a"]==2 && row["b"]==3;} return false;}
public static bool DifferentCaller() {Caller<string> c=new Caller<string>(); G<int> g=new G<int>(); return c.Write(g);}
public static bool ScalarControl() {Bag b=new Bag(); b.Scalars.Add(1); return b.Scalars.Contains(1);}
public static bool ClassControl() {Bag b=new Bag(); Item i=new Item(); b.DirectClasses.Add(i); return b.DirectClasses.Contains(i);}
public static G<int> CreateInt() {return new G<int>();}
public static G<string> CreateString() {return new G<string>();}
